slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
To copy triangle ABC by SSS: draw a ray from a new point D and mark DE = AB with the compass. From D, draw an arc of radius AC; from E, draw an arc of radius BC. They cross at F. Then DE = AB, DF = AC and EF = BC, so triangle DEF is congruent to triangle ABC by SSS.

You can also copy by SAS: copy side AB, copy angle A at D, and mark DF = AC along the new ray.
